title: The fixed untwisted comparison commutes with restriction to the scalar nonvanishing open.
statement:
The fixed untwisted comparison commutes with restriction to the scalar nonvanishing open. For all objects and arguments in the following signature, using [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], [def-pc-resolution-open-comparison-map].

theorem resolution_open_restriction_core {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (a : Γ(T, W))
    (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let b := ((f.app W) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).topIso.inv).hom a
    let s : Γ(𝟙_ Y.Modules, ⊤) := unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ b
    let c := resolutionOpenComparison f F I q W R
    ∀ (U : Y.Opens), (U : Set Y) = nonvanishingLocus (𝟙_ Y.Modules) s →
      ∃ d : P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)) ≃+
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G,
        ∀ x : P.obj (op W),
          (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q
            (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app G (c x) =
              d ((P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom x)

proof.text: The tensor unit has generator unitSectionsEquiv 1. The proved nonvanishing/generation equivalence and generatesAt_iff_mem_basicOpen identify its scalar section nonvanishing with the basic open of b. The inclusion image formula and preimage_basicOpen identify the image of U with f inverse D(a). Apply restriction naturality for that inverse-image open.
